'''''First Days on Tython''''' was an account of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] exploration of their recently rediscovered [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Published sometime after Tython's rediscovery in [[3651 BBY]],<ref name="Journal" /> ''First Days'' was among a list of suggested texts for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to read during the Cold War.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
''First Days on Tython'' was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', in a list of suggested texts in the section on [[Jedi Consular]]s.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
